title: Madras High Court flags mental toll on judges, lawyers, cops who review graphic evidence in sexual crimes
description: The Madras High Court recently commented on the severe mental and neurological toll it takes for judges, lawyers and the police to repeatedly review graphic digital evidence in sexual offense cases [Suji v. State].A Bench of Justices N Anand Venkatesh and KK Ramakrishnan was dealing with an appeal filed by a man convicted in a rape case.
